'''''Weigela florida''''' (syn. ''Weigela praecox''), the '''old-fashioned weigela''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Caprifoliaceae]].<ref name="POWO_150035-1" >{{cite POWO |id=150035-1 |title=''Weigela florida'' (Bunge) A.DC. |access-date=24 April 2025 }}</ref><ref name="RHS_101006" >{{cite web |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/101006/weigela-florida/details |title=''Weigela florida'' old-fashioned weigela |author=<!--Not stated-->|date=2025 |website=Find a plant |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=24 April 2025 |quote=5 suppliers }}</ref> It is native to Inner Mongolia, Manchuria, northern and south-central China, [[Primorsky Krai]] in the Russian Far East, the Korean Peninsula, and [[Kyushu]] in Japan, and it has been introduced to Bulgaria, Great Britain, Ireland, the United States, and Uzbekistan.<ref name="POWO_150035-1" /> A deciduous shrub reaching {{cvt|2.5|m|ft|0}}, it is typically found in scrublands and mixed evergreen/deciduous forests, at elevations from {{cvt|100|to|1500|m|-2}} above sea level.<ref name="RHS_101006" /><ref name="FoC_200022527" >{{cite web |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=200022527 |title=1. ''Weigela florida'' (Bunge) Candolle, Ann. Sci. Nat., Bot., sér. 2. 11: 241. 1839. 锦带花 jin dai hua |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2025 |website=Flora of China |publisher=Missouri Botanical Garden & Harvard University Herbaria |access-date=24 April 2025 |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123031919/http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=200022527 |url-status=live }}</ref> Recommended for screens and hedges, and attractive to hummingbirds, it is cold hardy in [[Hardiness zone|USDA zones]] 4 through 8, and requires full sun.<ref name="MBG_279017" >{{cite web |url=https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/PlantFinder/PlantFinderDetails.aspx?taxonid=279017 |title=''Weigela florida'' |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2025 |website=Plant Finder |publisher=Missouri Botanical Garden |access-date=24 April 2025 }}</ref>

==Cultivars==
